Name: Asaph
Summary: Asaph was a psalmist whose name heads twelve psalms, from the great Psalm 50 to the laments and histories of Psalms 73 to 83.
KeyStory: His psalms wrestle honestly with the prosperity of the wicked, the destruction of the sanctuary, and God's faithfulness to Israel's story.
KeyVerses: Psalm 50:1; Psalm 73:1; 1 Chronicles 6:39; 1 Chronicles 15:17; 1 Chronicles 16:5; Ezra 2:41; Nehemiah 7:44; Nehemiah 11:17; Nehemiah 12:35; 2 Chronicles 5:12; 2 Chronicles 29:30; 2 Chronicles 35:15
RelatedPeople: King David; King Solomon; King Hezekiah
LifeLesson: Asaph teaches that doubt and grief belong in worship — he brought his hardest questions to God instead of away from Him.
RelatedEvents: Cyrus's Decree and Return from Exile; Nehemiah Rebuilds the Wall
